title: RD-Gen: Random DAG Generator Considering Multi-rate Applications for Reproducible Scheduling Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.19460v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-time systems have various requirements such as the deadline and resource constraints. In addition, real-time systems are becoming larger and more complex, and studies on performance analysis and efficient scheduling algorithms are becoming increasingly important. Directed acyclic graph (DAG) models, which can express task dependencies and parallelism, are used for such studies. Random DAG sets are used to demonstrate the effectiveness and objectivity of methods proposed for real-time systems. However, there is no random DAG generation tool available that can generate a DAG set that considers the latest multi-rate applications. Therefore, researchers need to generate random DAG sets on their own, leading to additional effort and reduced reliability and reproducibility. translated_title: RD-Gen：考虑多速率应用的可复现调度评估随机DAG生成器
translated_abstract: 实时系统具有各种需求，如截止时间和资源约束。此外，实时系统正变得越来越大和复杂，对性能分析和高效调度算法的研究变得越来越重要。有向无环图（DAG）模型，能够表达任务依赖性和并行性，被用于此类研究。随机DAG集被用来展示为实时系统提出的方法的有效性和客观性。然而，目前没有可用的随机DAG生成工具能够生成考虑最新多速率应用的DAG集。因此，研究人员需要自行生成随机DAG集，这导致了额外的努力，并降低了可靠性和可复现性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个考虑多速率应用的可复现调度评估随机DAG生成器（RD-Gen）。RD-Gen还支持批量生成。
tldr: 提出了一种名为RD-Gen的随机DAG生成器，专为多速率实时应用设计，支持批量生成，以提高调度评估的可复现性和可靠性。
en_tdlr: Proposes RD-Gen, a random DAG generator designed for multi-rate real-time applications with batch generation support, enhancing reproducibility and reliability in scheduling evaluation.
